rows.protonation_method: Dimorphite-DL 2 empirical site rules at requested pH, pKa precision=0; amide/N–N sites retained from source; original graph/stereotags preserved; no microscopic pKa or tautomer ranking
warnings: Ligand protonation is a fixed model choice; it is not a binding-site pKa calculation or a tautomer ranking.

conversion_validation.method: Native Amber versus converted XML OpenMM Reference energy/force comparison at bound pose plus two deterministic 0.003 Å perturbations.

atom_mapping.method: Verified native atom names, elements and bonds; symmetric graph permutations are not used.
